name: Watch Wheel
description: Spin a wheel to choose what to watch from your Jellyfin library.
overview: A cinematic Jellyfin watch picker with Classic and Popcorn modes, filtering, watcher profiles, and personalized media selection.

versions.changelog: Major release: Popcorn Mode, CommunityRating rarity auras, watcher profiles, Classic theater atmosphere, improved filters and Settings, finalized Popcorn audio, and production hardening.
